# **SADIE Contributor License Agreement**

Thank you for your interest in contributing to **SADIE (Smart Data Escrow)**
(the "Project").

This Contributor License Agreement ("Agreement") documents the rights granted by
contributors to the Project's stewards.
It protects you as a contributor as well as the stewards and the Project's
users.
It does **not** change your right to use your own contributions for any other
purpose.

We require a signed Agreement before we can accept your contribution:

* **Individuals** sign **Part A** (Individual CLA).  
* **Companies** whose employees or agents contribute on the company's behalf
  sign **Part B** (Corporate CLA) and list their authorized contributors in
  Schedule A.

**Submission.** The mechanism depends on the Project's phase:

* **Private phase (current).** Contributors are engaged directly and are covered
  by their signed onboarding agreement on file — an individual assignment/CLA,
  or a Corporate CLA (Part B) for a company's personnel.
  No per-pull-request tooling is used; the signed agreement on file is the
  record of record.
  A single contractor building the core should sign an **assignment**-based
  agreement, not merely this license-in CLA.  
* **Public release.** Before opening the repository to pull requests from
  outside contributors, install a CLA-gating bot that requires each PR author to
  sign before merge and records the signature.
  The maintained hosted option is CLA Assistant (cla-assistant.io); a
  self-hosted GitHub Action variant keeps signatures inside the repo (preferable
  if you want no third-party service holding access to the org), but confirm it
  is actively maintained, as the original upstream Action was archived in 2026.
  Treat any hosted CLA service as a third-party subprocessor with access to the
  org, and inventory it accordingly.

---

## **Definitions (apply to both Parts)**

* **"Project"** means the SADIE (Smart Data Escrow) project and the products and
  works it manages (the "Work").  
* **"COSSAF"** means The Collaboratory for Open Software & Systems for Ag &
  Food, a fiscally sponsored project of VINE Institute.
  Any grant made to, and any right or obligation running to, COSSAF under this
  Agreement runs to **VINE Institute** for the benefit of that project.  
* **"TOTEM"** means TOTEM, LLC, a Washington State limited liability company.  
* **"Qlever"** means The Qlever Company, LLC, an Indiana limited liability
  company.  
* **"Stewards"** means COSSAF, TOTEM, and Qlever, collectively; **"Steward"**
  means any one of them.  
* **"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including any
  modifications or additions to an existing work, that is intentionally
  submitted by You to the Project for inclusion in, or documentation of, the
  Work.
  "Submitted" means any form of electronic, verbal, or written communication
  sent to a Steward or its representatives, including communication on
  electronic mailing lists, source-code control systems, and issue-tracking
  systems managed by or on behalf of the Project, but excluding communication
  conspicuously marked or otherwise designated in writing by You as "Not a
  Contribution."
